initialAttempt: Stopped at profile prefix assertion before any deletion.
cause: Runtime-owned TMPDIR differs from /tmp; the recorded profile is in the configured temporary parent.

patch.replacement: profile.is_absolute() and profile.parent in (Path('/tmp'), p.parent) and profile.name.startswith('playwright_chromiumdev_profile-')

scope: Only recorded task process profile locations are checked for absence; no profiles are deleted.
